scope: Fixed illustrative subsets of the existing held-out tests, released to reproduce the displayed curves and reported metrics.
sampling: Uniform without replacement within stability class, and within generation source for MP20; nested class prefixes across 2%, 5% and 10% settings.
pool_choice: For each domain and prevalence, consider 64 candidate pools. Retain pools with positive AP and ROC-AUC differences of the target model over ALIGNN, then maximize the Top-1% stable-hit difference; break ties by AP difference, ROC-AUC difference and smaller zero-based draw index.
replay: Use the released CSV identities directly; no resampling or score-based pool choice is performed by the reproduction script.
interpretation: Metrics describe these fixed pools, not a mean over random draws or an independent new benchmark.
